title: Current state of autobuild (2026-10-24)
summary: The installed service (v0.5) has not run since 22 Aug 2026: every start died with ModuleNotFoundError (git_sync), and nothing in Git showed it. v0.5.1 fixes the start and the download intake and is on main at packages/alchemy_autobuild_v0.5.1, tested locally, but it is NOT yet installed on the build host. On 23 Oct 2026 the 54 pending submissions were published to main by hand (NOT AUTOBUILD-QUALIFIED), and chats now also push directly to main. Until v0.5.1 is installed and has written a PASS receipt, nothing new is autobuild-qualified.
invariants: The last receipt written by the old service is 20260822T064900Z-CHATGPT-autobuild-v05: autobuild published its own broken successor with a PASS, then never started again.
Packages published by hand on 2026-10-23 are listed in autobuild/manual-publication/2026-10-23.json and carry no receipts.
Installing v0.5.1 is a job for Claude Code on the build host, following docs/autobuild/INSTALL_V051_WITH_CLAUDE_CODE.md, with Git intake paused until Tom enables it.

evidence.scope: v0.5.1 tests (5 end-to-end + 3 inherited) in a cloud workspace; not FIELD_PASS

provenance.claim: Root cause of the two-month outage.
v0.5 was published by autobuild with a PASS receipt.
Hand publication is explicitly not autobuild-qualified.
Install pauses Git intake before starting the service.
